options.label: F
options.text: The ideas of social Darwinism led to the passage of Prohibition laws.

options.label: G
options.text: The signing of the Treaty of Versailles contributed to the implementation of the New Deal.

options.label: H
options.text: The ideas of the Harlem Renaissance influenced the growth of the Civil Rights movement.

options.label: J
